summary.text: Eight Times Eight Is Eighty-Eight is an immortal killer move.

claims.text: Meng Qiu Zhen explores a dream realm inside the sovereign immortal aperture. He imparts a wisdom path method he names Nine-nine Multiplication Table, and he continues to spout nonsense as he teaches. In the final scene he keeps attacking his disciple and does not let him speak. The disciple gives up raging emotion and uses the nine-nine multiplication table method instead. After a long fight the disciple activates this killer move. It fails immediately. He suffers a backlash and becomes gravely injured. The disciple says the killer move is wrong. Meng Qiu Zhen tells him the real name is Eight Times Eight Is Sixty-Six, then attacks until he takes the disciple’s head.
